The photo shows the meal before eating, so the leftover has to be guessed. I'll assume a small amount is left, such as part of the avocado skin or some of the coffee, about 30 kcal. That puts eaten at roughly 510 kcal.

- Yogurt: 5 g protein, 20 g carbs, 3 g fat

- Avocado: 2 g protein, 6 g carbs, 15 g fat
- Egg: 6 g protein, 0 g carbs, 7 g fat

Totals: protein 21 g, carbs 45 g, fat 36 g.
